blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Pia Cayetano on Friday raised concerns over the marketing of so-called “flavored air” products and highly caffeinated energy drinks, warning that these could pose health risks to young people. Cayetano raised the concerns during the Senate’s deliberations on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Health (DOH) and its attached agencies, which was presented by Sen. JV Ejercito, chairperson of the Senate committee on finance. Directing her questions to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), an agency under the DOH, Cayetano sought to determine how the agency monitors products that could circumvent existing restrictions on electronic […]...
